### ShiitakeEffectOwner

```ts
type ShiitakeEffectOwner = ShiitakeEffectAgent &
  Readonly<{
    grants: Readonly<{
      deliver: (
        sessionId,
        delivery,
      ) => Effect.Effect<GrantsDeliveryResult, ShiitakeError>;
      read: (sessionId) => Effect.Effect<GrantsDelivery | null, ShiitakeError>;
    }>;
    withMeta: (meta) => ShiitakeEffectAgent;
  }>;
```

The in-process owner of a durable harness. Only the host holds it, so only the
host can write a Session's grants or attach metadata; no HTTP or remote client
can.

### readSessionSummaries()

```ts
function readSessionSummaries(
  owner,
  after?,
): Effect<
  Readonly<{
    sessions: readonly StoredSessionSummaryRow[];
    next: string | undefined;
  }>,
  ShiitakeError,
  never
>;
```

Enumerate saved conversations' stored facts in bounded pages, for readers that
hold only the store. Run status is not stored; use the Agent's `listSessions`
for it. An unreadable Session is its own `unavailable` row.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                  |
| --------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `owner`   | [`SqliteOwner`](index.md#sqliteowner) |
| `after?`  | `string`                              |

#### Returns

`Effect`\<`Readonly`\<\{ `sessions`: readonly
[`StoredSessionSummaryRow`](#storedsessionsummaryrow)[]; `next`: `string` \|
`undefined`; \}\>, [`ShiitakeError`](index.md#shiitakeerror), `never`\>
